spec_deviations.deviation: Task prompt asked for conserving series 'per maker/aggressor roles as the C5 conserving-channel definition requires', while prereg v2 C5 (panel R2-6) pins the PRIMARY endpoint to exactly two AGGREGATE channels with 'no per-actor or per-side series in the primary endpoint'.
spec_deviations.resolution: Primary series = the two aggregate channels per round (volume_units, cash_ticks). Role/side attribution is emitted as clearly auxiliary partition series (buy/sell aggressor side; aggressor_role/maker_role volume and cash; per-actor net ledger deltas), each a partition identity verified by conservation_violations.
spec_deviations.reason: Prereg v2 is the frozen statistical authority; the auxiliary attribution satisfies the task's role-attribution requirement without contaminating the endpoint.

spec_deviations.deviation: The build register does not define the clearing-round grid. The schema's round_id (client-controlled, uniformly 0 in the frozen fixtures; latency choices carry their own round namespace, e.g. round_id 1 beside order round_id 0) cannot define a deterministic grid, and E-1's F_exec projector (already built under the same register) pins the corpus grid to the engine clock: distinct execution clocks.match_ts ascending, requests at one tick merging, execution-free ticks excluded, round_id metadata only.
spec_deviations.resolution: E-4 adopts E-1's engine-clock grid verbatim (_execution_rounds groups execution records by execution.clocks.match_ts, ascending). The client round_id — including the latency namespace — is carried per round as sorted-distinct metadata only and never keys rounds. Execution-free rounds emit nothing (they carry no conserving-channel information), so no-execution sessions emit an empty series. Cross-item test verifies row-for-row agreement with project_fexec_corpus.
spec_deviations.reason: FactSurrogateBatch pairs features and channels per round t; if E-4 used any other grid the corpus contract would break wherever the two grids differ (e.g. uniform round_id 0 with several execution ticks, or several requests sharing one tick). Conservative narrower reading: reuse the sibling item's frozen grammar rather than inventing a second one.

spec_deviations.deviation: replay.regenerate() returns only the regenerated tape, not the engine, so engine state (cash/inventory) cannot be read from its return value.
spec_deviations.resolution: regenerate_with_engine() mirrors replay.regenerate's dispatch verbatim, reusing replay.py's own private coercion helpers (_as_int/_as_str/_subdict/_clocks), keeps the engine handle, and enforces replay()'s exact record-by-record comparison before any emission. Ledger snapshots are taken at request-event boundaries; because _settle is the only mutator of the four ledgers, per-round deltas are exactly the boundary states around each round's last execution. No modification to scripts/lab_asset/{matching,schema,replay,adapter}.py.
spec_deviations.reason: Spec requires extraction via the existing replay/regenerate path with no engine modification; mirror+guard is the minimal reuse that cannot silently diverge (any divergence fails the byte-exact guard).

spec_deviations.deviation: The C5 channel scaling s_ch is not emitted.
spec_deviations.resolution: Out of scope by construction: C5 pins s_ch to the hash-sealed DGP-only sample branch computed from the D0-committed generator sample (never simulator output, never the paired corpus).
spec_deviations.reason: Emitter stays a pure (prestate, tape) instrument; s_ch belongs to the E-2/D0-freeze side.
